Inquest Finds Police Failures in Belfast Schoolboy's Death

An inquest into the death of Noah Donohoe, a schoolboy who disappeared in Belfast, has identified failures by the Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI). The jury began their fifth day of deliberations. Details about Noah Donohoe's character, described as inquisitive, kind, and bright, were presented during the inquest. The inquest examined the circumstances surrounding his disappearance and subsequent death.
